notes.title: April 3rd Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Quick update on Lockes The Thief! 

We got 10 reviews, finally! So I think we should be on the Discovery Queue. 

I am working on the sequel, which is already feeling loads better, but I am still updating this version as well! 

For example, I noticed people were having some problems with our auto save feature. SO I updated that! Now you won't get stuck in a death loop! 

Remember, I'm here if you have any issues! Let me know how I can help! And thanks for playing! 

->Prescott 'Lockes' Lawani

PS: Don't forget to join our mailing list or discord to get more updates on the game AND the sequel!

notes.title: Another Lil Patch
notes.content: Hey everyone! I just now patched the game again. Now it knows when you are using a keyboard or XBox controller. Sorry no Playstation or Nintendo controller UIs. Also I fixed an error with the inventory window and the camera moving into certain views when reading signs. Give it a whirl!

notes.title: Big Fat Patch
notes.content:
No not a patch on the character Fat, but a Big Fat Patch! 

So after some toil with a good friend, the Auto Save System has been implemented! No more annoying saving problems! Hopefully that is solved for good! 

And also a glitch that I won't talk about has been fixed as well! 

Keep me posted on those reviews and critiques! I really appreciate all of it! 

-From Your Favorite Thief
